note: peak = 2 x api (10) + 2 x worker (12) + migrate 0 (finishes before the deploys) + backup 1 + operator 2. If the host plan's max_connections is below ceil(peak / 0.8) = 59, the pools shrink (api 5+2, worker 4+4) before G3. app_backup adds 2 only while the backup cron runs (its connection limit); the plan counts its one connection.
